interpretation: Holding the named work and ten-section structure relatively constant, the paper witness occupies a much broader page regime. The comparison supports a material affordance argument but does not establish direct palm-leaf-to-paper recopying because copy lineage, chronology, hand and container relation remain uncontrolled.
